Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Cabinet with Inner Shelf, 15"W, Walnut
Materials: Wood
This cabinet boasts timeless, mid-century elegance with a walnut veneer that complements a broad variety of decors. The 2 large drawers provide ample storage, and the top inner shelf offers easy access to books, tablets, and other items. 27.6"W x 15.0"D x 29.5"H Solid wood and MDF with walnut veneer Classic mid-century style with simple design One top inner shelf with 2 drawers for ample storage space Assemble in 15-30 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
